annotations.title: See which AI bots a website lets in

description: Reads the public robots.txt of a website and reports which AI bots it lets in, by purpose: AI training (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Meta-ExternalAgent, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot and more), AI search and answers (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, DuckAssistBot), assistants opening pages for a person (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User, MistralAI-User) and classic search engines (Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot). Also reports the shared AI-training opt-out line (User-agent: __usage_ai-training, the IETF draft that Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic said they will honor), Content-Signal and Cloudflare managed blocks, plus plain-language notes and a suggested choice for doorman_build_robots.

url.description: Website address or domain, e.g. nytimes.com
